- **Diplodia_Ear_Rot**: Brown kernels, no prominent green mold — ruled out

The test image matches Aspergillus Ear Rot references most closely. The dense, powdery olive-green to gray-green mold starting at the ear tip and covering downward to the middle, with clean yellow kernels below, is characteristic of Aspergillus.
